description: This file defines the LoanChargePaidDetail class, a data transfer object holding details of a paid charge related to loan repayments, including amount, installment, and fee status.

classes.name: LoanChargePaidDetail
classes.description: A data container representing details of a paid loan charge, including amount, installment, and whether it is a fee charge.

methods.name: LoanChargePaidDetail
methods.description: Constructor initializing the LoanChargePaidDetail with specified amount, installment, and fee status.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of the paid charge.

methods.name: getInstallment
methods.description: Returns the installment associated with the charge.

methods.name: isFeeCharge
methods.description: Indicates whether the charge was a fee.
